deterministic_checks.message: [RS-27 Schema validity] All 7 structured artifacts validate against the v0.2.0 schemas.
[RS-07 Objective referential integrity] Every objective_id cited by 4 content units, 57 items and 75 claims resolves in the registry (32 nodes in this topic branch, 31 assessable).
[RS-07 Claim referential integrity] Every claim_id cited by a content-unit block or learning item exists in the topic ledger.
[RS-07 Claim orphans] All 75 ledger claims are cited by at least one block or item.
[RS-40 Meaningful objective mapping] Every (item, objective) mapping is backed by a cited claim that serves that objective.
[RS-05 Coverage floor - items (meaningful mappings only)] All 31 assessable objectives are practised by at least one item under RS-40.
[RS-05 Coverage floor - content units] All 31 assessable objectives are taught by at least one content unit.
[RS-39 Offline reconstructibility] Every claim cited by a learning item is also taught in a content-unit block.
[RS-41 No bulk stamp] All 100 stamped artefacts are consistent: every advanced stamp is matched by changed text or by a recorded reviewed_unchanged decision.
[RS-41 No stale derivative] No stale derivative: every block and item was authored against the current revision of every claim it cites.
[RS-17 Syllabus modality coverage] Every objective whose syllabus wording names a chart, graph or diagram is practised in that form.
[RS-22 Stated arithmetic is correct] All 0 stated calculations in canonical answers evaluate correctly.
[RS-25 Flashcards are self-contained] No flashcard depends on facts held only in another card.
[RS-22 Interpretation is interpretation, not a second check] No quantitative item passes off an arithmetic check as interpretation.
[RS-22 Graphical stimulus is consistent and necessary] No graphical task in this topic, so nothing to verify.
[RS-22 Magnitude claims carry their figure] Every magnitude claim in a quantitative answer is backed by a stated figure.
[RS-33 Unqualified universals] No unqualified universal or exclusivity statement found in claims, learner prose or answers.
[RS-21 Third-party certainty] No statement asserts a third party's decision as certain.
[RS-36 Assessment-priority claims need assessment evidence] No learner-facing claim about examiner behaviour, mark priority or question frequency.
[RS-15 Scope discipline - excluded constructs] None of the 12 constructs the contract excludes appears in learner-facing material.
[RS-35 Variant completeness] Every variant-register term used in this topic names its consequential forms.
[RS-34 Generalisations declare their scope] Every grouping or across-the-board statement declares the members it claims to hold for.
[RS-19 Command-word discipline] No item prompt instructs with a command word absent from this level (Use, What, Which).
[RS-37 Command-word-shaped practice] Every objective with a command word carries an item that instructs with one of them.

[RS-38 Declared answer structures] Literal subtype vocabulary does not establish Chemistry credit structure. Template prefixes were removed after independent review. Credit-point counts are checked by audit_production.py; semantic rubric adequacy remains an explicit independent review gate. 57 items do not name every declared part of their subtype answer structure in marking guidance: ITEM-6117-9-001-DIST (missing: difference, reason); ITEM-6117-9-002-APP (missing: given); ITEM-6117-9-003-APP (missing: given, reason); ITEM-6117-9-004-INTERP (missing: data, conclusion); ITEM-6117-9-005-APP (missing: given, reason); ITEM-6117-9-006-INTERP (missing: data, conclusion) ...
[RS-19 Subtype to AO consistency] Every item's assessment objectives are permitted by its subtype.

[RS-19 AO mix against target] AO mix by item count {'A': 62, 'B': 36, 'C': 2} against target {'A': 50, 'B': 30, 'C': 20}; largest deviation across AO1-AO3 is 18 points. AO4 is reported, not tested by count: 0 items carry it, of which 3 are performance tasks (multiple_choice_set, practical_task, short_answer). RS-19 measures the AO4 share in practice time.
[RS-25 Flashcard integrity] All 54 flashcards carry a non-null canonical answer and a declared subtype.
[RS-25 One target per flashcard] No flashcard asks for several separate answers in one card.
[RS-25 Duplicate prompts] No exact duplicate and no near-duplicate prompt pair above 0.85 Jaccard across 57 items.
[RS-30 Marking guidance present] All 57 items carry marking guidance.
[RS-12 Items cite a claim] Every item cites at least one ledger claim.
[RS-13 Publication gate] Gate holds: 0 of 75 claims are publishable or verified. 75 are generated_gap and need documented human approval (RS-13).
[RS-31 QA status consistency] Every content unit and item carries a recognised qa_status.
[RS-09 Word budget] 2 content units sit outside their declared word budget.
[RS-05 Exposure required subtypes] Every exposure-required subtype is present or waived in writing.

[RS-32 Packet hash manifest] Critic-packet hash manifest written for 29 files to topics/9/packet.sha256; the manifest's own SHA-256 is detached in packet.sha256.hash (03b122b2601ce204) so the whole packet is verifiable.
[RS-43 Conditioned mechanisms carry their conditions] All 1 assertions of a registered conditioned mechanism carry every condition the register requires.
[RS-44 Answers do not supply their own facts] No answer in this topic asserts a completeness fact.
[RS-45 Derived exposure metadata recomputes] All 31 computed exposure entries for this topic recompute from the evidence map, satisfy the file's own class definitions, and keep no superseded figures.
[RS-46 Quantities are named in their own units] No quantity is named in units it is not measured in.
[RS-47 Depictions are generated, not authored] No item in this topic shows a generated depiction.
[RS-45 Contract counts match the live build] All 3 counts the contract authorises match the build: 57 learning items, 4 content units.
[RS-48 Practice texts are declared, original and the stated length] No item in this topic is answered from a practice text.

blockers: No deterministic opinion on 4 checks (C-35, C-16, C-41, C-43) - on these a human or model reviewer is the only line of defence.
Chemistry release hold: independent semantic/rubric/visual re-verification and user release approval remain open. Mechanical success is not publication approval.
notes: Standard v0.2.0-draft check suite. 44 checks: 38 pass, 0 fail, 2 warn, 4 not_run.
A not_run check means an input the check needs is absent. It is never a pass.
RS-30: these are mechanical results computed by code. They say nothing about whether the material teaches the subject well.
Generic standard decision was publish. Chemistry HANDOVER and the user require independent re-verification before publication; the subject adapter enforces that stricter policy.
